plan: Given my value of $30, I aim to bid slightly above what I estimate other bidders might value the prize at, to maximize profit. Assuming others bid close to their value, I will bid $30.1 to potentially win while paying a lower price (the third-highest bid). This strategy balances winning chances with profit, as winning at a bid lower than my value ensures a positive return. I assume others will not exceed their value significantly, so bidding just over $30 should suffice.

Given my private value of $28, I aim to bid just below $28 to maximize profit if I win. Assuming others bid around their private values, I will bid $27.9 to outbid those with slightly lower values. Bidding higher risks a negative payoff if winning. If others bid higher, I lose without cost. This strategy balances winning chances and profit.

Given my value of $22, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Assuming others bid close to their values, bidding around $21 could win if their values are lower. This strategy balances winning potential with minimizing overpayment.
